checks: opening driving controls does not resize or overlap desktop map
attached-state selection retains its outline, label and inspector
compact snapshots retain all physical static actors
actual Bullet box center keeps height and does not flatten collision pose
physical orientation basis becomes full 3D rotation
active and retained collisions name their object and physical step
collision history survives after contact ends
smoothing remains between received poses and never changes authoritative state
paused frames do not continue moving or retain interpolation
saved real Bullet contact frame preserves its actual center and object identity
reset discards prior raised pose and smoothing history
small-screen driving controls remain outside the map and page width
leaving a room clears interpolation and pending animation
road selection retains original and updated highlighters after batching
original map selection still switches road geometry
updated map selection still switches road geometry
batching preserves every triangle, line segment, dashed distance and material
camera and map review issue no simulation stepping commands

input.poses: explicit synthetic completed-state fixtures; no native physics

limits: CPU submission cost is measured, not native MetaDrive FPS or MacBook FPS.
Actual vehicle control is validated separately by outputs/interactive-platform-usability/report.json.
Interpolation only changes display mesh positions between received completed states; server API state is untouched.
Display checks inject completed poses over actual map geometry; this is not a simulation physics benchmark.
Performance numbers use local software-rendered Chromium, not the users Mac. Authoritative Planning observations are never interpolated.
